note: 문장이해(sentComp) 신규 장면 생성 스펙. generate_sentcomp_images.py 입력. 정답/오답은 '같은 두 인물의 역할(방향)만 반대'가 되도록 prompt를 작성한다 (한눈에 누가 누구에게 하는지 명확해야 검사가 유효). sentence/altText는 한국어, image prompt는 영어 권장.

items.characters: a man with short black hair wearing a red t-shirt, and a woman with long brown hair wearing a blue dress

correct.prompt: The MAN (red t-shirt, short black hair) on the LEFT is holding out and giving a flower bouquet to the WOMAN (blue dress, long brown hair) on the RIGHT, who reaches out to receive it. The bouquet is in the man's hands, moving toward the woman.

distractor.prompt: The WOMAN (blue dress, long brown hair) on the LEFT is holding out and giving a flower bouquet to the MAN (red t-shirt, short black hair) on the RIGHT, who reaches out to receive it. The bouquet is in the woman's hands, moving toward the man.

items.characters: a police officer in a navy uniform and cap, and a thief in a black-and-white striped shirt with a small eye mask

correct.prompt: The POLICE OFFICER (navy uniform and cap) is grabbing and holding the arm of the THIEF (striped shirt, eye mask). The police officer is the one catching; the thief is caught and looks surprised.

distractor.prompt: The THIEF (striped shirt, eye mask) is grabbing and holding the arm of the POLICE OFFICER (navy uniform and cap). The thief is the one catching; the police officer is caught and looks surprised.

items.characters: a small child in a yellow shirt, and an old man with white hair and a cane

correct.prompt: The small CHILD (yellow shirt) is pushing the OLD MAN (white hair, cane) from behind with both hands. The child is the pusher; the old man is being pushed forward and stumbles.

distractor.prompt: The OLD MAN (white hair, cane) is pushing the small CHILD (yellow shirt) from behind with both hands. The old man is the pusher; the child is being pushed forward and stumbles.

items.characters: a white rabbit with long ears, and a green turtle with a shell

correct.prompt: Side view, both moving left to right. The TURTLE (green shell) is in FRONT, the RABBIT (white, long ears) is BEHIND following and chasing the turtle. The rabbit follows the turtle.

distractor.prompt: Side view, both moving left to right. The RABBIT (white, long ears) is in FRONT, the TURTLE (green shell) is BEHIND following and chasing the rabbit. The turtle follows the rabbit.

items.characters: a woman hairdresser in a pink apron holding scissors, and a man sitting in a chair with a cape

correct.prompt: The WOMAN (pink apron) is standing and cutting the hair of the MAN (sitting in a chair, cape) with scissors. The woman holds the scissors and cuts; the man sits still.

distractor.prompt: The MAN (pink apron) is standing and cutting the hair of the WOMAN (sitting in a chair, cape) with scissors. The man holds the scissors and cuts; the woman sits still.

items.characters: a mother with a bun hairstyle in a green shirt, and a small child in orange

correct.prompt: The MOTHER (green shirt, bun hairstyle) is carrying the small CHILD (orange) on her back, piggyback style. The mother stands and carries; the child rides on the mother's back.

distractor.prompt: The small CHILD (orange) is carrying the MOTHER (green shirt, bun hairstyle) on its back, piggyback style. The child stands and carries; the mother rides on the child's back.
